about: Pilot scenes: one widescreen picture a pilot. close is the avatar's square (the head); side is where the pilot stands, so text goes on the other side; crops are the largest box of each aspect that keeps the pilot; chart, on a few, says the scene shows the sea on a display. Written by Tools/Build/pilot_art/scene.py manifest.

MANGER.name: Tamako Deephook
MANGER.treatment: Field documentary, a long lens from far off
MANGER.source: profession: a hunter who wades the feeding flats sets a lure line

ZODIAC.name: Ivelia Starreach
ZODIAC.treatment: Travel reportage on slow slide film, dusk in a chart house
ZODIAC.source: history: "was apprenticed to a cartographer" (the game's Upbringings)

NEEDLE.name: Ilia Silvergate
NEEDLE.treatment: Architectural interior with a shift lens, verticals true
NEEDLE.source: profession: an aristocrat whose house keeps a harbour's sea gate stands the last watch of the night

GALLEON.name: Haradek Anchorkeel
GALLEON.treatment: Cinematic film still, anamorphic, one work lamp
GALLEON.source: hobby: "ties a ribbon on the hull for every friend lost" (the game's Quirks)

Echo.name: Echo
Echo.treatment: Candid snapshot by a crewmate, desk-lamp light
Echo.source: hobby: "keeps a jar of every crystal they have ever missed" (the game's Quirks)

Longshift.name: Longshift
Longshift.treatment: High-key expedition frame, pale on pale
Longshift.source: want: "to see the edge of the map" (the game's Wants)

Tenacious.name: Tenacious
Tenacious.treatment: Aftermath portrait, medium format, eye to eye
Tenacious.source: profession: a first responder, in the first minute after a rescue

Spare05.name: Halven Frostgate
Spare05.treatment: Snow-light interior, large format, very still
